speaker: Doctor
text: Can you describe exactly how your gait has changed over time, and do you experience any numbness or tingling in your extremities? Have you had any recent falls or loss of consciousness?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that description. Have these symptoms been present for more than a month, and have you noticed any changes in your vision, such as double vision or blurred sight? Also, do you experience any trouble speaking or swallowing?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML) secondary to natalizumab therapy. REQUEST IMAGES: MRI_Brain_with_contrast. REQUEST TEST: JC_Virus_serology.
